originating_prompt:
Can you create a visual for Assets that are not under AMC  give an option to select the asset category , Branch 

create another visual which will provide details of all AMC along with the assets which will expire or have already expired on a date - give an option to select the branch and all branches
result_summary:
Both visuals built in SQL mode (no shared schema needed). Now running the data validator to independently verify the numbers before wiring them into navigation.Both visuals validated cleanly. Now publishing them to navigation so they're reachable in the app menu.Good — there's a "Reports & Analytics" folder already housing similar visuals. I'll file both new visuals there.Both are now in the "Reports & Analytics" menu folder. Last step is updating the FRS to document these two new reports.I'll add two new sections right after the "Warranty / AMC Expiry (V)" section, matching the existing style.## Assets Not Under AMC (V)
- Visualization: Grid over the Asset Register.
- Purpose: lists assets that are NOT currently covered by any AMC contract (AMC_APPLICABLE flag is not 'Y').
- Criteria: Asset Category (optional, lookup to Asset Category Master, defaults to all categories); Branch (optional, lookup to Branch Master, defaults to all branches).
- Columns: ASSET_CODE, ASSET_NAME, CATEGORY_NAME, BRANCH_NAME, STATUS, MAKE, MODEL, PURCHASE_DATE, PURCHASE_COST.

## AMC Coverage & Expiry (V)
- Visualization: Grid joining AMC Contracts -> AMC Contract Line -> Asset Register.
- Purpose: shows AMC contract details together with each covered asset, restricted to coverage that has already expired or will expire by a selected date.
- Criteria: Expiring On or Before (date, defaults to today) filters to contract lines whose END_DATE <= this date; Branch (optional, lookup to Branch Master, defaults to all branches).
- Columns: AMC_CONTRACT_NO, AMC_VENDOR_CODE, START_DATE, END_DATE, CONTRACT STATUS, ASSET_CODE, ASSET_NAME, BRANCH_NAME, CATEGORY_NAME, DAYS_TO_EXPIRY, EXPIRY_INDICATOR.
- Sort: END_DATE ascending (most overdue / soonest expiring first).

## Asset Movement History (V)"}Both visuals are built, validated, published to the menu, and documented. Summary:

**Files touched:**
- `Metadata_Model/visual_models/model_fam_assets_not_under_amc.json` (new) — grid of Asset Register rows where `AMC_APPLICABLE <> 'Y'`, filterable by Asset Category and Branch (default: all).
- `Metadata_Model/visual_models/model_fam_amc_coverage_expiry.json` (new) — grid joining AMC Contracts → Contract Line → Asset Register, showing contract + covered-asset details, filtered to coverage expiring on or before a selected date (default today), with an optional Branch filter (default: all branches), sorted soonest-expiring first.
- `application.json` — both registered under the existing "Reports & Analytics" folder via `publish_to_navigation`.
- `requirement_doc.md` — new sections added for both visuals under Warranty & AMC reporting.

Both were independently verified by the visual-data-validator (row counts and filtered results reconciled against the base tables) — PASS with no critical findings. One informational note: the "AMC Coverage & Expiry" grid filters only on end date, not contract status, so a Draft/Cancelled contract with a past end date would still appear — this matches what was asked, but flag if you'd rather restrict it to Active/Renewed contracts only.

Files touched: requirement_doc.md, application.json, Metadata_Model/visual_models/model_fam_assets_not_under_amc.json, Metadata_Model/visual_models/model_fam_amc_coverage_expiry.json
